purpose: Prove the authenticated multi-tenant cloud API over one ephemeral loopback listener with temporary SQLite state and no Agent execution or effects.
architectureChange: add a Node built-in HTTP edge adapter around the existing transport-independent handler
derive tenant and user from one synthetic opaque session mapping instead of request parameters
exercise two isolated test tenants against temporary SQLite identity, Capability Registry and Agent Studio providers
keep every production composition, consumer, provider, scheduler and writer unchanged
allowedActions: open exactly one ephemeral IPv4 loopback listener on 127.0.0.1 port 0 during the pilot
create and remove one temporary SQLite database and synthetic test-tenant fixture directory
send only fixed synthetic JSON requests for device registration, capability listing and Agent draft listing
use only Node built-in modules and existing repository code; install no dependency
retain only status codes, tenant-isolation assertions, bounded counts and digests
close the listener and database before the pilot exits
commit and push the exact implementation after all gates pass
explicitExclusions: bind a non-loopback interface or fixed port
configure DNS, TLS certificates, SSH, firewall, reverse proxy or cloud infrastructure
use real users, credentials, devices, messages, business data, customer data or user workspaces
execute an Agent, executor, tool, lifecycle handler or external effect
install third-party code or change DSH/Cordis and product composition
activate the client or private Work Integration Pack
switch or duplicate a consumer, provider, scheduler or writer
migrate live data, delete a source or restart a service
validation: real loopback HTTP roundtrip for two synthetic tenants
prove body tenant injection fails before a provider call
prove same user and device ids remain tenant-isolated across SQLite reopen
assert listenerClosed=true, executorInvoked=false, effectsActive=0 and currentOwnerPreserved=true
private pack audit and root agent sync check

rollback.method: Close the ephemeral listener, close SQLite, remove the temporary fixture directory, then revert the single pilot implementation commit.

approvalPhrase: 批准 capability-platform-cloud-edge-pilot-03，基于 revision fdfb10be20ccd3f14fd423b403dfb26c00c64d68，严格按授权单执行。
